title: Promotion Exam: Scoring Mangan and Above
description: A promotion exam with no yaku shown: count the han from a riichi mahjong hand and answer scores of mangan and above. You can make at most one mistake
questionPrompt: Answer the score for this win
koTsumoScore: Score (from each non-dealer / from the dealer)

howToPlay.title: Question format
howToPlay.lead: You will get questions like this. The yaku are not shown, so count the han from the hand yourself and answer the score.
